description: Privileged teacher-plan labels captured per decision by the instrumented teacher. Auxiliary training targets ONLY (V2-B).

fields.plan_a_attack: int; opponent Pokemon index [active]+bench the teacher plans as the 200-dmg main target (-1 none, 0 active, k bench k-1)
fields.plan_a_counter: list[int]; spread damage-counter allocation for plan_a (indices into opponent [active]+bench)
fields.plan_b_attack: int; plan assuming main target = current opponent active (i==0)
fields.plan_b_counter: list[int]; spread allocation for plan_b (consumed at DAMAGE_COUNTER_ANY, main.py L705)
fields.use_support: int card id; the Supporter the teacher plans to play this turn (0 none)
fields.bench_attacker: bool; a benched Dragapult ex is charged (>=2 energy)
fields.can_switch/can_attack/can_main_attack: bool capability flags refreshed at MAIN
fields.prize_inference: list[int] card ids the teacher infers are in its own prizes
fields.scores: list[float]; teacher per-legal-option score vector (argmax/top-k -> action)
fields.argmax_option/top1_score/top2_score/scor: teacher's chosen option and confidence margin
fields.plan_recomputed_this_decision: bool; True iff SelectContext.MAIN (planner ran this decision)
